packageRules.description: Playwright: never bump unattended, and never bump one half alone. `playwright` and `@playwright/test` are held at the same version on purpose — Playwright bundles its own Chromium, and a different Chromium rasterises text and antialiasing differently. Every baseline on the `preview/main` branch was captured with this one, so a bump invalidates the whole set at once and the next PR's visual diff reports fake changes on every fixture. Adopting a new Playwright means republishing baselines in the same change, which a bot cannot do — hence `automerge: false`, overriding the preset's auto-land for minor/patch. Grouped so the two versions can never desync; dashboard-gated so the upgrade is a decision rather than a Monday morning surprise.

@types/vscode declares the minimum VS Code version this extension supports, and it has to stay in step with `engines.vscode` in package.json — which Renovate does not update. Bumping the types alone silently lets code compile against APIs older editors do not have; bumping both drops users on older VS Code. Either way it is a support-policy decision, so it waits on the dashboard and never auto-lands.
three and @types/three must move together: the typings track the runtime's version line exactly, and a mismatch fails the webview build rather than degrading gracefully.
